diagnostic_evidence.quote: To prove Theorem \ref{ganzwien}, recall from (\ref{wassdef}) that the Wasserstein distance $\mathscr W_1(\mu, \nu)$  involves suprema over $1$-Lipschitz functions $F: \mathscr C \to \R$. Then we have

issues.failure_explanation: The given proof of Theorem \ref{ganzwien} only bounds the Wasserstein distance between the conditional law of $Y_N=\sqrt N(u_\theta-u_{\tilde\theta_N})$ and the law of $Y=Du_{\theta_0}(Z)$ (terms I and II). The theorem also asserts $\sqrt N (u_{\tilde \theta_N} - u_{\theta_0}) \to_{\mathscr C}^d \mu$; this concerns the random, data-dependent centring $u_{\tilde\theta_N}$ and does not follow from convergence of the conditional laws of $Y_N$. No argument for the second display appears anywhere in the proof (the analogous step for Theorem mainbvm was done by a separate moment/centreing argument).

failure_location.quote: $$\mathscr W_1(\mu_{N}, \mu) \to^{P_{\theta_0}^\mathbb N} 0 ~~\text{ as well as }~~\sqrt N (u_{\tilde \theta_N} - u_{\theta_0}) \to_{\mathscr C}^d \mu.$$

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the short deterministic argument: by Theorem mainbvm, $\sqrt N(\tilde\theta_N-\theta_0)\to^d Z$ in $H^{-k-2}$; by the established continuity of $Du_{\theta_0}:H^{-k-2}\to\mathscr C$ and the interpolation estimate already displayed for term I (applied with the single deterministic increment $\tilde\theta_N-\theta_0$, using $\|\tilde\theta_N-\theta_0\|_{L^2}=O_P(\tilde\delta_N)$ and $\|\tilde\theta_N\|_{H^{\bar\gamma}}=O_P(1)$ from (\ref{meanreg})), $\sqrt N\|u_{\tilde\theta_N}-u_{\theta_0}-Du_{\theta_0}[\tilde\theta_N-\theta_0]\|_{\mathscr C}=o_P(1)$; Slutsky's theorem then gives the second display.
issues.overall_effect: The second stated limit of Theorem \ref{ganzwien}, and the prose claims built on it (uniform tightness of $\sqrt N(u_{\tilde\theta}-u_{\theta_0})$, concentration of $u_{\tilde\theta}(t)$ near $u_{\theta_0}(t)$, and the supporting role in the credible-band application (\ref{cbandlim})), are unsupported by the proof as written.
issues.title: Second limit of Theorem ganzwien (CLT for the centred posterior mean) is never proved
issues.why_classification: A short, routine Slutsky/continuous-mapping argument assembled from estimates already proved in the paper restores the missing display verbatim; no rate, regime or guarantee is lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: J_N \in \mathbb N, J_N \simeq N \delta_N^2,~~K_N = K_{N,\bar \kappa} = \sqrt N \delta_N \max(1,J_N^{\gamma-\bar \kappa}).

issues.failure_explanation: With $\delta_N=N^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d)}$ and $J_N\simeq N\delta_N^2$, the quantity $\delta_N^2\sqrt N\,J_N^{\gamma-\bar\kappa}$ equals $N^{(\gamma(d-1)+d/2-d\bar\kappa)/(2\gamma+d)}$, which tends to zero only if $\bar\kappa>\gamma(d-1)/d+1/2$; the source claims it equals $N^{-(\bar\kappa-d/2)/(2\gamma+d)}$, an identity that holds only for $d=1$ or $\bar\kappa=\gamma$. Constraint (\ref{ks}) only gives $\bar\kappa<\kappa-d/2<k-d$ with $k$ independent of $\gamma$, so for permitted parameters (e.g. $d=3$, $\zeta=1.6$, $\eta_0=2+d/2$, $\gamma=100$, $k=15$, both satisfying Theorem \ref{mainbvm}'s hypotheses $\gamma>\max(3\zeta+3d/2+2,\eta_0)$, $k>\max(\zeta+5d/2,\eta_0)$) the exponent is positive and the first Cameron–Martin term grows like a power of $N$ instead of vanishing. The same failure affects (\ref{quadbd}): $\delta_N^2 J_N^{2(\gamma-\kappa)}=N^{2[d(\gamma-\kappa)-\gamma]/(2\gamma+d)}\to0$ requires $\kappa>\gamma(d-1)/d$, again not implied. Hence the Radon–Nikodym factors in the proof of Theorem \ref{laplaceapp} do not vanish uniformly on the unit ball, the stated $r_N(t,\psi)=o_{P}(1)$ is not established, and the uniform exponential bound (\ref{fullbd}) used for term b) of Proposition \ref{prop:added-1} collapses.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen the hypothesis of Theorem \ref{mainbvm} (and \ref{bvminv}) to $k>(d-1)\gamma/d+d+1$, so that (\ref{ks}) permits $\bar\kappa>\gamma(d-1)/d+1/2$ and $\kappa>\gamma(d-1)/d+d/2$; under this additional condition both displayed Cameron–Martin bounds tend to zero and the given proofs apply verbatim. The reaction-diffusion application is retained by choosing $\gamma$ and $k$ accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: Theorem \ref{laplaceapp} is unproved under its stated hypotheses, so Proposition \ref{prop:added-1} (tail control of term b)) and both conclusions of Theorem \ref{mainbvm} are unsupported; Theorem \ref{bvminv}'s claim that the approximation holds for every $k>3d$ is likewise unsupported (the proof only works for $k$ growing linearly with $\gamma$). The $\mathscr C$-space Theorem \ref{ganzwien} survives, since its proof may choose $k$ large.
issues.title: False N-exponent identity in the Cameron–Martin bounds of the Laplace-transform approximation
issues.why_classification: The resolution is a contained hypothesis change (restricting the advertised range of $k$ to values proportional to $\gamma$) after which the existing proofs apply unchanged; but the stated topology claim of Theorems \ref{mainbvm}/\ref{bvminv} must be weakened, which is more than a routine local fix yet causes no major loss.

issues.failure_explanation: The source $m$ of the equation for $r$ is the second-order Taylor remainder, $|m(t,x)|\le \tfrac12\|f\|_{C^2}|w(t,x)|^2$ with $w=u_{\theta_0+h}-u_{\theta_0}$, so $\|m(t)\|_{L^2}\simeq\|w(t)\|_{L^4}^2$. The written step replaces $\|w(t)\|_{L^4}^2$ by $\sup_t\|w(t)\|_{L^2}^2$, i.e. it uses a uniform bound $\|w\|_{L^4}\le C\|w\|_{L^2}$, which is false: $w(0)=h$ may concentrate while staying in the $H^{\bar\gamma}$-ball, and $\|e^{t\Delta}h-h\|_{L^2}\to0$ gives $\|w(t)\|_{L^4}\ge c\|h\|_{L^4}$ for small $t$, with $\|h\|_{L^4}/\|h\|_{L^2}$ unbounded over the ball. The estimate (\ref{tbdu}) invoked in the display controls only the $L^2$-norm of $w$, so the claimed chain of inequalities is an invalid inference as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound in time-integrated form instead: from (\ref{inhom}) with $a=0$ and zero initial data, $\sup_t\|r(t)\|_{L^2}^2\lesssim\int_0^T\|m\|_{L^2}^2dt\le \tfrac{\|f''\|_\infty^2}{4}\sup_t\|w\|_\infty^2\int_0^T\|w\|_{L^2}^2dt\lesssim C(B)\|h\|_{L^2}^4$ using the uniform $L^\infty$-bound from Condition \ref{gemol}A)/(\ref{h2estimate}) and the energy bound (\ref{tbdu}); this yields (\ref{quadap}) with $C=C(B,\bar\gamma,T)$.
issues.overall_effect: The $O(\|h\|_{L^2}^2)$ linearisation estimate (\ref{quadap}) is not established by the given proof; through it, the verification of Condition \ref{gemol}C) in Theorem \ref{bvminv} and the use of Theorem \ref{linrob} in the proof of Theorem \ref{ganzwien} (the $I$-term estimate and the $\mathscr C$-valued extension) are left unsupported.
issues.title: Invalid pointwise-in-time Taylor-remainder estimate in the proof of the linearisation theorem
issues.why_classification: Only the classification rationale is required here: the repair is local and routine and preserves every substantive claim, so the issue is minor.
